summary: Stocks are pushing higher Tuesday, with the Nasdaq fresh off a record close Monday as investors keep betting on the AI boom. Futures are green and Treasury yields are easing off multi-year highs.
market_note: Index futures up across the board with oil slipping and yields cooling ahead of earnings season.

items.why: Oil fell as resilient Middle East exports and a G7 emergency reserve release eased supply concerns, Reuters reported, with Brent dipping below $100 despite Houthi attacks on Saudi targets.
Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575, citing Meta Muse AI agent demand as a big new chip catalyst, while CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase 2027 shipments.
Nvidia helped carry the Nasdaq to a record high Monday as investors kept betting on the AI boom; Reuters reports the chip giant is now valued at $5.8 trillion.
Microsoft was one of the heavyweights powering Monday record Nasdaq close on AI boom bets, with futures pointing higher again Tuesday ahead of earnings season.
